senses.definition: vb. be blunt, dull (NH id.; Aramaic קְהָא, ܩܗܳܐ );—
Impf. 3 fpl. תִּקְהֶינָה Je 31:29, 30 Ez 18:2 (all of teeth).
in sense of Qal: Pf. 3 ms. קֵהָה Ec 10:10 if the iron be blunt.
